name: Deploy
why: A merged change, from build to live, and back when it fails
ideal: Merges deploy in minutes from a CI build, rarely fail, roll back within the hour, read per service for lead time, failure and recovery.

steps.name: Build
tools: The deploy platform's build on merge
steps.rule: Every merge builds and deploys on its own; nobody deploys by hand.

steps.name: Ship
steps.rule: A merged change is live within hours, not batched for later.

steps.name: Verify
tools: The live page's text, read in the app's browser
steps.rule: A deploy that fails its checks counts as a failed change.

steps.name: Restore
tools: Rollback to the last good version
steps.rule: A failed deploy rolls back to the last good version before anyone debugs it.
